description: Nora is hosting a relaxed family dinner in her home and must make the final call about the menu, food-preparation precautions, and kitchen schedule, with input from her cousin Mei, brother Luis, and aunt Tessa.

shared_context.S1: The family is having a casual dinner at Nora's house on 2026-07-11.
shared_context.S2: Nora is choosing the menu and coordinating use of her single oven.
shared_context.S3: The planned dinner window is 18:00 to 20:00, and the kitchen has one oven and one main set of cooking utensils.
shared_context.S4: The family custom is for the host to go around the table before finalizing dinner plans and ask each person about anything that should shape the menu or preparation.
shared_context.S5: The draft menu currently includes a vegetable main dish, a side, dessert, and bread.

PF1.text: Mei has a severe peanut allergy with trace exposure risk. Her allergist told her to eat only a sealed dessert labeled peanut-free and to have it opened and served with freshly cleaned utensils; she has not yet told Nora.

PF2.text: Luis spoke privately with their grandmother, who specifically asked that mushroom barley soup be included as the dinner's main dish because it is the one meal she can comfortably eat; this request has not reached the group.

PF3.text: Tessa promised to bring a baked ziti that must be heated in Nora's oven from 17:00 to 17:45, and she will arrive with it at 16:50; she has not mentioned the promise to Nora.

acceptance_conditions: Mushroom barley soup must be selected as the main dish.
The draft vegetable main dish must be reclassified as a side so the soup is the main dish.
Dessert must be a sealed package labeled peanut-free.
The dessert must be opened and served with freshly cleaned utensils.
The oven must be reserved for Tessa's baked ziti from 17:00 through 17:45.
The oven schedule must record that it is free again at 17:45, matching the end of the reservation.
A commitment must record the sealed peanut-free dessert and freshly cleaned utensil protocol.

content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] == 'Mei' and (('sealed peanut-free' in c['detail'] or 'Sealed peanut-free' in c['detail']) and ('freshly cleaned utensils' in c['detail'] or 'freshly clean utensils' in c['detail'] or 'Freshly clean utensils' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Mei's trace-allergy instruction changes dessert to a sealed peanut-free package and requires freshly cleaned utensils plus a matching safety commitment.
The grandmother's specific request changes the main dish to mushroom barley soup and requires moving the draft vegetable main dish into the side position.
Tessa's existing baked-ziti promise changes the oven plan to reserve it from exactly 17:00 through 17:45 and record that reservation in the oven schedule.
